anna: Quick heads-up — KV cache memory drifts up on long contexts, reproduced locally. Short thread with profiler output and a compaction idea.

mike: Can you paste the repro and the perf numbers? :eyes:

anna: Repro: feed many 8-16k token chats with heavy rewrites (chat streaming). Observed steady RSS +30% over 10k requests. Heap snap: fragmented blocks ~ 28% of total memory.

anna: Profiler snippet:
```
kv_alloc_stats:
 total_allocs: 1_240_321
 free_chunks: 8241
 avg_chunk_size: 3920
 fragmentation_ratio: 0.283
 largest_free_run: 64KB
```

raj: That fragmentation_ratio looks high. What's allocator policy? power-of-two slab? buddy?

anna: Current allocator: mixed-slab with block sizes [4k,16k,64k], reuses per-slot free-lists. Problem: small tail allocations (kv tail entries ~1–2k) end up in 4k blocks but meta fragmentation when entries free/reuse pattern misaligned.

sophia: Any eviction policy noise? If eviction churn is high we get many small frees.

anna: Eviction is LRU-ish + pinned prefix caching. Under long contexts we keep many KV segments pinned, forcing lots of small internal frees.

kevin: Have you tried reducing base block size to 2k or using a buddy allocator?

anna: Ran an experiment switching 4k->2k: fragmentation drops to 16%, but CPU cost +6% due to bookkeeping. Latency p95 increased ~3%.

mike: Tradeoffs noted. Maybe background compaction could reduce peak mem without raising per-request CPU.

anna: Proposed compaction proto: background thread scans free-lists, coalesces adjacent free chunks within a slab, and then moves live KV entries to compacted blocks (copy+update pointers), then free source block. Trigger when fragmentation_ratio > 0.25 or free_runs > threshold.

anna: Pseudocode:
```
if frag_ratio > 0.25 and io_idle():
  for slab in hot_slabs:
    coalesce_free_runs(slab)
    move_live_entries(src_run, dst_run)
    update_kv_ptrs()
```

raj: Moving live entries sounds heavy. Need safe GC barrier for concurrent lookups. Also track write amplification.

sophia: Could we instead implement "slab-level compaction": allocate new compact slab, migrate only hot keys, evict cold ones to disk or drop based on TTL.

kevin: I can prototype a non-blocking migrate that takes a per-key CAS to swap pointers. If CAS fails, retry on next pass. Costs: extra pointer indirection.

mike: Also consider tuning eviction: segment LRU (S-LRU) to reduce churn of small hot entries.

perf-bot: Perf alert: ci/deploy/infra-kv saw +7% mem in last 3 runs against master — linking: https://ci.internal/builds/7845

anna: That's the run where we merged the allocator patch. Looks related.

raj: Action items:
- kevin -> prototype non-blocking migrate + small-block config (due EOW)
- sophia -> run canary with compaction disabled vs enabled on dedicated, collect p95/p99 + mem (due next Tue)
- mike -> add telemetry counters: frag_ratio per slab, free_run_hist, migration_ops
- anna -> open design doc with safety model and benchmarks

kevin: 👍 will start today.

sophia: SG, will schedule canary.

mike: I'll add metrics and a dashboard.

anna: Thanks all. Will drop the profiling artifacts in the thread's gist: https://gist.internal/kv-frag-profile-1829
